title: Gyroscope Orientation Data Explorer
description: Tip a sensor board three ways and watch exactly one of the three readings move each time.
creator: Coding Club
author: Dan McCreary
subject: Coding Club
chapter_title: Sensor, Sound, and IoT Project Kits

educational.audience: Students reading orientation data from a kit

pedagogical.learningObjective: Given a tilted or rotated orientation of a gyroscope kit, the learner interprets which of the pitch, roll, and yaw values changes and by how much.
pedagogical.interactionPattern: Drag the coloured handles to tip, roll, and rotate the board
pedagogical.assessment: Name which axis changed from the readouts alone, without watching the board.
